decisions.summary: Review date is fixed; retrieval time is separate
decisions.concern: Sources are read in October but the review is as of 26 August 2026.
options: Use retrieval date as as-of date
Use assigned review date and record retrieval times separately
decisions.source_basis: Assignment scenario; interview 03:34 PM ('The review is as of August 26, 2026').
decisions.chosen_behavior: as_of is always the --review-date; every source attempt records its actual retrieved_at.
decisions.rationale: Conclusions must be about the legal and factual position on the review date.
tradeoffs: Later legal changes are not reflected unless the review date is changed by a human
decisions.downstream_effect: Stage 03 checks each legal version was effective by the review date.
